name: celya
description: Installer npm sur macos # Download and install nvm: curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.3/install.sh | bash

scripts.build: npm run build:global && npm run build:product && npm run build:category && npm run build:cart && npm run build:checkout && npm run build:account
scripts.dev: tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input.css -o ./assets/css/output.css --watch & tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input-product.css -o ./assets/css/output-product.css --watch & tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input-category.css -o ./assets/css/output-category.css --watch & tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input-cart.css -o ./assets/css/output-cart.css --watch & tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input-checkout.css -o ./assets/css/output-checkout.css --watch & tailwindcss -i ./assets/css/input-account.css -o ./assets/css/output-account.css --watch & wait
